releases.displayName: New Locomotion, Blocking, and Fake Snaps - July Title Update

items.text: What’s up, Maximum Football fans!

We are excited to publish our first major update to Maximum Football since launching into 1.0 last month. This update includes a number of bug fixes, gameplay improvements, and feature updates designed to address some of the main points of feedback we’ve been hearing from the community since 1.0 launch.

In our most recent Dev Blog, we shared that a new CPU playcalling system was in the works. During testing over the past week, we identified several areas that need further refinement. To ensure it meets our standards and delivers the best experience, we’ve decided to move the release of this feature to the August update.
Here’s what’s included in the update.
We’ve continued our work on refining player movement to make gameplay feel smoother, more responsive, and more lifelike. This update includes several key changes to how players move on the field:

Speed-Based Animations: Players now transition more naturally between movement speeds. As a player accelerates, their running animations update to match—limbs move faster, and strides lengthen to reflect the pace.

Improved Transitions: We’ve smoothed out the transitions between idle and movement, especially when changing directions. This is most noticeable on screen plays and short routes—where previously, receivers would hesitate after catching the ball. Now, they’ll fluidly transition into their next movement, getting upfield more quickly and realistically.
These updates are part of our ongoing effort to make every movement—from a quick cut to a breakaway run—feel as clean and satisfying as possible.
Blocking has been a key area of focus leading into 1.0, and while earlier updates improved run blocking and special teams performance, this update zeroes in on pass protection.

Pocket Formation Improvements: Offensive linemen are now better at forming and maintaining the pocket. Rather than chasing defenders out of position, they focus on threats directly in front of them—helping to seal off interior gaps and reinforce the wall around the quarterback.

QB-Aware Blocking Logic: Linemen now have improved awareness of the quarterback’s movement. They’ll work to steer pass rushers away from the QB’s current position, helping reduce pressure from blindside or broken-pocket scenarios.
These changes are designed to create a more realistic and reliable pass protection experience—and give your quarterback the time they need to make the right throw.
You can now use a fake snap to keep the defense guessing.
Tap RB (Xbox) / R1 (PlayStation) at the line of scrimmage to perform a hard count.
Use it to try and draw the defense offsides or disrupt their timing before the snap.
Mix this into your pre-snap routine to gain an edge against aggressive defenders.

releases.displayName: New Update Adds Coach Mode and More

items.text: What’s up, Maximum Football gang. We have a brand new update for you, and this one includes a feature that’s been requested since before we launched back in November – Coach Mode! But that’s not all. Here’s a look at some of the biggest changes you’ll notice in this update.

Don the headset or the old Lombardi fedora and outstrategize your opponent with coach mode. Available in exhibition and Dynasty Mode, Coach Mode puts the clip board in your hands, allowing you to call the plays while the CPU handles the rest. Watch your team execute your gameplan as you attempt to dominate the Xs and Os from the sidelines.

To activate Coach Mode, simply enter an exhibition or dynasty game and from the team select screen, press the menu key or V. You will see coach mode activated over your team name. Now, start your game and call your plays. You will have the ability to toggle the spectator cameras during the game as you coach.

We know that an XP based progression system in Dynasty isn’t everyone’s cup of tea, so we are introducing Sandbox Progression in this week’s patch. This allows players to bypass the current XP system and freely change the individual ratings for players on their rosters and the rosters of other teams however they want! You can toggle this option from the settings menu in Dynasty mode.

We are currently in the middle of a massive locomotion overhaul in Maximum Football, and this update is the first step of a few over the never few patches to reword player movement in the game. You will notice some new running animations including a more aggressive sprint where a ball carrier puts his head down running with the ball. Player movement is also improved in both fluidity and responsiveness.

We want to ensure the online experience is enjoyable for players who commit their time to competing against others in MPL. To that end, we have made some changes to the way sportsmanship impacts matchmaking. Now, the game is going to attempt to matchmake players with similar sportsmanship scores against one another online.

releases.displayName: Card Pack Issue Update for Maximum Pro League Players

items.text: We want to provide an update regarding the current issue affecting card packs in Maximum Pro League (MPL). We are aware that new users attempting to enter MPL, as well as existing users trying to open card packs, are encountering an error.
We have identified the root cause and are actively working on a solution to restore normal functionality to card pack openings in MPL.

Existing Card Packs: If you attempt to open a card pack already in your inventory, you will receive a timeout error or a message indicating the card was not created. The pack will remain in your inventory and will not disappear. Once the issue is resolved, you will be able to open all packs you have purchased.

New Purchases: If you attempt to purchase a card pack you don’t currently own, the same error will occur. However, after restarting the game, the currency will be deducted, and the pack will appear in your inventory (marked with “Free x1” in the store). These packs will remain unopened until the issue is fixed.

New Users: MPL relies on the creation of new cards to build your initial team. As a result, new users will not be able to access MPL until the issue is resolved. All starter packs will be available to open once the fix is in place

A fix is in development and will be available in our next update. This fix will take some time and will require a patch for both Steam and Xbox. Until then, we encourage users to NOT attempt to purchase or open packs in MPL.

We understand the frustration this may cause and apologize for the inconvenience. Challenges such as this come with the territory of an early access launch, and we are committed to getting MPL back up and running as soon as possible. We appreciate your patience and will continue to provide updates as we implement solutions, including a permanent fix planned for the near future.

releases.displayName: Card Pack Purchases Are Now Working

items.text: Hi, everyone. We have resolved the issue that caused players to lose inventory when opening up packs without receiving items. This is a temporary fix while we work on a permanent solution.

For now, users will be able to purchase and open packs, as expected. However, you may see some unexpected results in terms of customizing your cards. This is an expected bug while we work on a more long term solution.
If

you are still encountering any issues, be sure to completely restart your game. On Steam, exit out of Steam and restart. If you are still encountering issues after these troubleshooting steps, please respond to this post with specifics on how you encountered the error.

We appreciate everyone's patience while we worked through this and apologize for any inconvenience. If you were impacted by this issue and lost out on card packs as a result, please remember to fill out the form here. https://forms.gle/5o54DnNw543Cxd98A When the team logs back on in the new year, we will be processing these forms and helping to resolve individual account issues.

releases.displayName: Patch 4

items.text: What’s up Maximum Football community. Today we are launching our 4th update to the Steam Early Access build and 2nd for Xbox Game Preview. This will be our final update of 2024 with our next coming sometime in January of 2025.

Adjustments for defensive back abilities. With our last patch, we over corrected for the number of tipped interceptions and other weird plays in traffic. This update attempts to rebalance interceptions and limit the number of catches made by receivers in double and triple coverage.

Increase in coin earnings in MPL: We have heard from the start that the current rewards for playing games in MPL made it difficult to accrue enough coins to upgrade players. This patch increases the coin payouts for both online and offline MPL matches.

Changes to depth chart function in Dynasty: Our longterm goal is to implement the depth chart UI from MPL across all of our modes, but for now we have made a short-term adjustment to the way depth charts work in Dynasty mode. This change should make it easier to rearrange your depth chart.
You can check out the detailed patch notes below.

As I said before, this is our final update of 2024. We want to thank everyone who has downloaded the game, left reviews, and given us feedback. The game is better today than it was when we launched back in November thanks to you!
2025 is going to be a big year for us. We just released our roadmap for the first half of the year. You can check that out here to learn more about what to look forward to.
Adjustments to defensive back catching abilities and swats to allow for more interceptions and less catches in double and triple coverage.

Name corrections for jersey patterns, face paints, and other customization items

Increased coin earnings for online and offline

Fixed a bug where the host would get stuck in the lobby if the client timed out.
Fixed overtime scores on match history
Made UI improvements to depth chart in non-MPL modes
Fixed a bug where a user would be given menu options as if they were offline when actually connected

releases.displayName: Update 3

items.text: What's up, Maximum Football community! We are back with a brand new update that adds a bunch of gameplay improvements, a new ping-based matchmaking system, and more. Here are some of the major additions in this update.

Various bug and quality of life fixes.

You can check out the full patch notes at the end of this blog. The patch includes dozens of AI adjustments to account for the newly added play action passes as well as a number of technical fixes to matchmaking.

The update also adds our first Season Pass, Gridiron Glory! Play the game to unlock free rewards like cosmetics, currency, and card packs. Upgrade to the premium Season Pass to double your rewards and get access to the new Aircraft Carrier stadium at level 50.

releases.displayName: First Update Available for Maximum Football

items.text: What’s up, Maximum Football community. Today we are launching our first update that addresses a number of the most commonly reported issues amongst our community. You can download today’s update now.
The two main issues we sought to resolve in this update were ragequitters in multiplayer matches and passing/catching across all game modes.
Here are some of the main fixes available in today’s patch. You can find more detailed patch notes below.

Introducing a system to penalize ragequitters. Players who quit a match early will receive a loss, lose LP, and not earn post-match rewards. Players who remain will receive a win, LP, and their post-match rewards.
Improvements to matchmaking resulting in an improved connection rate.
Stability improvements.
Fix for players losing control of the ball carrier and passing abilities.
Improvements to passing and catching.
Adjustments to accelerated clock in multiplayer matches.
Improvements to the custom logo explore page to address crashes.
UI Fixes.
Improved profanity filtering for custom teams.

We are continuing to monitor community feedback and prioritize fixes to gameplay and across all of our game modes. We appreciate all of you who have created discussion threads, left reviews, and interacted with us on Discord and social. We are building this game alongside you, and today’s patch will hopefully help to improve your experience in both online matches, exhibitions, and Dynasty mode.
Fixed an issue where lead blockers would not search for a target along their path.
Fixed an issue where receivers would get stuck in a block animation when pressed.
Fixes for several animation blends to address snap animations
Fixes to defensive presnap adjustments for blitzes and zones.
Catch animations updated across a variety of game situations to improve responsiveness and catching.
Fixed an issue where receivers would not align themselves correctly with the predicted catch starting pose.
Fix an issue with sideline receivers hitching when they are free, triggering locomotion stopping that causes them to miss catches.
Fixes to AI’s handling of movement in various receiver routes.
Fixes to hitch-route AI receivers getting stuck strafing after catching the ball.
Increased minimum kick power. Reduced maximum kick angle. Updated kick indicator to reflect the minimum and maximum angle of the kick.
Fixed an issue with runningback motions in gun formations.
Fixed empty audible selection when audibling out of extra point kick defense.
AI QBs can now pass to halfbacks and full backs.
Fixes to sideline catch animations.

Introduced a system to penalize users who disconnect during an MPL match. Players who remain will receive a win, LP, and post game rewards. Players who disconnect will receive a loss, lose LP, and not receive post game rewards.
Added leave game notification for online players who remain in the match after their opponent quits.

Improved profanity filtering for custom teams in online play.

Collapsed empty video player in drills selection screen.

items.text: The feedback that we have been receiving about the latest update to the Maximum Football Open Beta has been great! The new Real World Speed has made gameplay faster by making player speed match real college athletes, with 40-yard speeds between 4.2-5.7 seconds, depending on rating.

releases.displayName: Early Access Launch Update

items.text: Maximum Football Community,

The dedication and excitement you’ve shown for Maximum Football is incredible and your passion continues to drive us to create the best football experience possible. So that we can accomplish this, we have made the decision to move Steam Early Access into 2024 and are first planning a Beta that allows community members to get hands-on playtime and share feedback. While the team focuses on getting the Beta ready, we'll share development updates a bit less than usual, and we look forward to sharing awesome new insights with you in the future.

The Maximum Football Team: Question: Why the delay?: Answer: Even though we’ve been pleased with the progress of development thus far, we feel that to deliver a title that meets or exceeds expectations more time is needed for development.: Question: What is Early Access?: Answer: Early Access is a place where games are playable in an alpha or beta state while they are under continued development. Games in Early Access should be considered unfinished. The reason for Early Access is it allows gamers to play and provide feedback to help shape a game and its features.: Question: When is Early Access available?: Answer: 2024: Question: Why bring MXFB to Steam Early Access instead of releasing the full game?: Answer: We believe that providing access to players in an early state allows us to gather crucial feedback from the community to build the best possible experience.
